name: Perfection
look: Three stacked movie stills on the right with white space at left for captions. Michael Fassbender, in a black turtleneck in a dim room with tall windows, looks up and gazes ahead, his expression turning more impressed and approving in each panel.
use: The captions on the left build something up step by step, and his growing approval peaks at the final step, often a ridiculous combination he finds perfect.
slots: first part (left of the top still)
second part (left of the middle still)
the final touch (left of the bottom still)
